description: Fix caption words or the key-word colour of a finished video, without a new edit; timing never moves. Either rewrite lines (from, to, text from get_project_context captions) or swap words everywhere with replace: [{ heard, spelled }] (brand names, people). Each spoken word keeps a caption word, so a 2-word name cannot become 1 word here: use remember plus revise_video. To spell a name right in later videos too, use remember. 5 a day per video. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version to fix, from get_project_context; the live one when left out.

lines.description: The caption lines to rewrite, from get_project_context captions (from, to, text).

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

replace.description: Swap words everywhere they appear, e.g. a brand name: [{ heard: "Clip Mint", spelled: "ClipMint" }].

heard.description: The words as the captions show them.

name: fix_captions

outputSchema.description: Clypmint fix_captions result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Fix captions
